The '''LCS 2023 Spring''' was the first split of the 2023 [[League of Legends Championship Series]] season, organized by Riot Games. It took place from January 26 to April 9, 2023, with the Regular Season held at the Riot Games Arena in Los Angeles, United States, and the Finals at the PNC Arena in Raleigh, United States. Ten franchised teams competed in a Double Round Robin {{Abbr/Bo1}} Group Stage, followed by a Double Elimination {{Abbr/Bo5}} Playoff bracket. The total prize pool was $200,000 USD. The top two teams from the Playoffs qualified for the [[Mid-Season Invitational/2023|2023 Mid-Season Invitational]].

==Format==
* '''Group Stage''' - 
** Double Round Robin
** Each team plays 18 matches.
**All matches are {{Abbr/Bo1}}
*** {{bgcolortext|seedup|''1st till 4th place''}} advance to the Upper-bracket of Playoffs.
*** {{bgcolortext|up|''5th and 6th place''}} advance to the Lower-bracket of Playoffs.

* '''Playoffs ''' - 
** Double Elimination
** All matches are {{Abbr/Bo5}} 
** Winner and the runner-up qualify for [[Mid-Season Invitational/2023|Mid-Season Invitational 2023]]
